product_overview: Ders Rotası is a web-based curriculum planning and academic tracking app for students and parents. Students can log study activity and track syllabus completion, while parents can unlock a dashboard to review analytics and adjust study rotas.
core_goals: Track daily study sessions, questions, and correctness rates
Monitor curriculum and syllabus completion progress
Unlock and review parent-side academic analytics
Adjust study plans and daily curriculum loads based on performance

features.name: Student Curriculum Checklist & Study Log
features.description: Lets students review their curriculum tasks, mark items completed, and record study activity such as duration, question counts, and correctness metrics.
user_flows: Navigate to /child -> View the curriculum task list -> Mark study items as completed -> Record study duration, total questions, and correctness metrics -> Review updated study progress
Navigate to /child -> View the daily study rota -> Check off tasks as they are finished -> Review syllabus tracking progress
Navigate to /child -> Enter study session details -> Save the log -> See the curriculum progress update

features.name: Parent Passcode Lock
features.description: Provides a local passcode gate before a parent can access the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /parent/lockscreen -> Enter the parent passcode -> Submit the passcode -> See the parent dashboard
Navigate to /parent/lockscreen -> Enter an incorrect passcode -> Submit the passcode -> See an incorrect password message

features.name: Academic Performance Analytics & Graphs
features.description: Shows parents visual summaries of student progress, including completion, correctness, study duration, and subject-level distributions.
user_flows: Navigate to /parent/dashboard -> View completion rate charts -> Review correctness percentage visuals -> Review study duration trends -> Understand overall academic progress
Navigate to /parent/dashboard -> View subject distribution charts -> Compare subject performance patterns -> Review current performance metrics

features.name: Intelligent Rota Planning & Risk Assessment
features.description: Helps parents trigger recalculation of study plans and adjust daily curriculum loads using academic performance and risk signals.
user_flows: Navigate to /parent/dashboard -> Trigger plan recalculation -> Review the updated study rota suggestions -> Adjust the student daily curriculum load
Navigate to /parent/dashboard -> Review academic risk signals -> Compare performance consistency and task load -> Apply a revised study plan
Navigate to /parent/dashboard -> Adjust curriculum pacing -> Review the recalculated schedule -> Confirm the new study load

routes.description: Main landing screen where users choose between Student (Child) and Parent modes

Main parent panel containing child academic analysis, risk models, study rotas, and planning workspaces

known_limitations.issue: Performance bottlenecks when handling large study records (6000+)
known_limitations.impact: Re-rendering parent-child states on every action may freeze the interface on mobile/tablet devices
Big lists are drawn on the DOM simultaneously instead of using virtual viewport virtualization, risking page crashes
